name: Silverio Palacios
biography: Silverio Palacios Montes is a Mexican actor, screenwriter and director with a long career in film, theater and television. He is known for his roles in award-winning films such as "Matando cabos", "Y tu mamá Tambien", "La Delgada Linea Amarillo", "El Violín", among others.
